name: Ferienbauernhof Niedermühlbichler
beschreibung: The Gasthof Ferienbauernhof Niedermühlbichler is located in the municipality of Söll in the Tiroler Sölllandl. The surrounding area is characterized by mountains and farmland. In summer, marked hiking trails lead directly from the accommodation into the surrounding mountain landscape. In winter, the SkiWelt ski area is reachable within a few minutes' drive. The facilities include a traditional tavern with regional Tiroler cuisine as well as simple, functionally furnished rooms. The atmosphere is quiet and rural, catering to hikers, skiers and families who appreciate uncomplicated accommodation. The establishment also runs a small farm with farm animals.
